LESSON: A HAND WRITES ON THE WALL

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.5: A hand writes on the wall

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on A hand writes on the wall. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: whatever they do at home, school and in church. Why did the hand appear on the wall?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the story of a hand writing on the wall

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: A HAND WRITES ON THE WALL
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
A hand writes on the wall helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: A HAND WRITES ON THE WALL
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Explain the story of a hand writing on the wall

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the story of a hand writing on the wall. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the story of a hand writing on the wall.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “A hand writes on the wall”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the story of a hand writing on the wall. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what A hand writes on the wall is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “A hand writes on the wall”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: explain the story of a hand writing on the wall)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach A hand writes on the wall to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the story of a hand writing on the wall.
3. Make one local Kenya example of A hand writes on the wall from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for A hand writes on the wall: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study A hand writes on the wall?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. whatever they do at home, school and in church. Why did the hand appear on the wall?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what A hand writes on the wall means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the story of a hand writing on the wall.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
